2105-3499-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3499-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3499-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2239-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-3129-4094-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1619-2438-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4496-5220-5332-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5231-5470-7296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3789-3899-4552-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1849-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-1849-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-2417-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-2974.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

3464-3657-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
3464-3657-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Rofellos.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-5709.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

1580-4871-5147-5542.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

856-2438-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

974-2011-5446.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Esika's Chariot.
974-2011-5446.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Esika's Chariot's crew ability by tapping the Smaug token, causing Esika's Chariot to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Esika's Chariot as an attacker.
Esika's Chariot's second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
974-2011-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may copy any other token(s) you control instead. You may also attack with a Warrior to get infinite creature tokens with haste.

2060-2313-3525-3574.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-2313-3525-3574.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-2313-3525-3574.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

338-2558-3490-3910-5296.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-2558-3490-3910-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
338-2558-3490-3910-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek and another artifact, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.

4067-4798-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4067-4798-5631-5686.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, untapping target artifact, land or creature.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

2713-4031-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Ardent Electromancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

276-1110-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1309-1987-3836-5002.notablePrerequisites:
Urza, Lord Protector and The Mightstone and Weakstone melded into Urza, Planeswalker.
You control a basic Island.
1309-1987-3836-5002.description:
Activate Urza, Planeswalker's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing instant spells you cast this turn to cost {2} less and causing you to gain two life.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and a basic Island.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-2532-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
1537-2532-5231.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
The Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zealous Conscripts token, adding {R}.
The Zealous Conscripts token dies, triggering itself, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2292-2721-3839.description:
Cast Changeling Hero by paying {4}{W}.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield, championing Bloodline Necromancer.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Changeling Hero.
Changeling Hero dies, causing Bloodline Necromancer to return to the battlefield from exile.
Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, returning Changeling Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 an infinite number of times.

3201-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
3201-3932-4222.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Arixmethes and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
